sentence: The Universal Declaration begins from equal dignity and rights and names differences that must not cancel that equality (United Nations 1948)
passage:
Source: https://www.un.org/en/about-us/universal-declaration-of-human-rights

Article 1
All human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights. They are endowed with reason and conscience and should act towards one another in a spirit of brotherhood.
Article 2
Everyone is entitled to all the rights and freedoms set forth in this Declaration, without distinction of any kind, such as race, colour, sex, language, religion, political or other opinion, national or social origin, property, birth or other status. Furthermore, no distinction shall be made on the basis of the political, jurisdictional or international status of the country or territory to which a person belongs, whether it be independent, trust, non-self-governing or under any other limitation of sovereignty.

sentence: A visual discourse study of 15 Nordic fast-fashion advertisements found complex portrayals that did not necessarily dislodge stereotypes (Srivastava et al. 2022)
passage: This study analyses the visual construction of girls and notions surrounding young femininities articulated by 15 contemporary advertisements of Nordic fast fashion companies, available on their public Facebook pages in Finland. A visual discourse analysis identi fi es some blatantly stereotypical and a few complex visual constructions of girls as heterosexual, caring, innocent, sexy posers, active self-presenters and self-surveyors, carefree and environmental activists. The implications of our fi ndings, particularly in shaping societal notions surrounding girls, are discussed. The study contributes primarily to the research fi eld of visual commercial representation of girls by unpacking how their complex portrayals can create an equivocation that eventually resurrects stereotypes surrounding young femininities. It advances studies on Nordic consumer culture by highlighting that girls ' portrayals by Nordic companies may not clearly re fl ect the values of state feminism. The study can bene fi t marketers by sensitising them to how the complex visual representations of girls may (re)produce stereotypes.

sentence: The Sustainable Fashion Communication Playbook recommends reducing messages of overconsumption and recognising people's capacity to demand wider change as citizens (United Nations Environment Programme 2023)
